BCCE_CARD_HACKER.title: Hacker
BCCE_CARD_HACKER.description:
ALL players [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Dark[/gold].
Immediately trigger the passive ability of all their [gold]Dark[/gold] Orbs once.
BCCE_CARD_COMMAND.title: Command
BCCE_CARD_COMMAND.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()} extra for each other player.
BCCE_CARD_UNIDENTIFIED_FLYING_OBJECT.des:
ALL players choose 1 of {Cards:diff()} random Colorless cards to add into their [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
Whenever ANY player plays a Colorless card, a random enemy loses {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
BCCE_CARD_WALTZ_NOCTURNE.title: Waltz Nocturne
BCCE_CARD_WALTZ_NOCTURNE.description:
Add {Cards:diff()} [purple]Inky[/purple] [gold]{Cards:plural:Shiv|Shivs}[/gold] to ALL players' [gold]Hands[/gold].
Gain {SneakyPower:diff()} [gold]Sneaky[/gold] this turn.
BCCE_CARD_VOLCANO.title: Volcano
BCCE_CARD_VOLCANO.description:
ALL players draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}, then each [gold]Exhausts[/gold] any number of cards from their [gold]Hand[/gold].
For each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold], apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BCCE_CARD_VOLCANO.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose any number of cards in your Hand to [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
BCCE_CARD_IGNITE.title: Ignite
BCCE_CARD_PENETRATE.title: Penetrate
BCCE_CARD_PENETRATE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Next turn, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
BCCE_CARD_SWIFT_STRIKE.title: Swift Strike
BCCE_CARD_SWIFT_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Discard 1 card.
BCCE_CARD_GOLDEN_SNAKE_BITES.title: Golden Snake Bites
BCCE_CARD_GOLDEN_SNAKE_BITES.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} {Repeat:plural:time|times}.
Each hit applies [gold]Poison[/gold] equal to the damage dealt.
BCCE_CARD_PHANTOM.title: Phantom
BCCE_CARD_PHANTOM.description:
Discard your entire [gold]Hand[/gold].
Gain 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] for every {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} discarded.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for every {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} discarded.
BCCE_CARD_APHONIA.title: Aphonia
BCCE_CARD_APHONIA.description:
At the end of your turn, gain {AphoniaPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] for each card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
At the end of your next turn, lose that much [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
BCCE_CARD_ELITE_HUNTER.title: Elite Hunter
BCCE_CARD_ELITE_HUNTER.description:
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Your next Attack is free to play.
If this is an Elite or Boss combat, gain an additional {EliteStrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {EliteDexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
BCCE_CARD_AMBUSH.title: Ambush
BCCE_CARD_AMBUSH.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Choose an Attack in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It gains [gold]Sly[/gold] this turn.
BCCE_CARD_AMBUSH.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose an Attack to gain [gold]Sly[/gold] this turn.
BCCE_CARD_TEST_CARD.title: Test Card
BCCE_CARD_TEST_CARD.description: If you obtained this card, something went wrong.
BCCE_CARD_DRAW_SWORD.title: Draw Sword
BCCE_CARD_DRAW_SWORD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
If any enemies intend to [gold]Attack[/gold], gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to half the lowest total attack damage among them.
BCCE_CARD_MEMORY.title: Memory
BCCE_CARD_MEMORY.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]{Cards:plural:Wound|Wounds}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
At the end of this turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all Status cards in ALL your piles that have not already been [gold]Exhausted[/gold]. Gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] for every 2 cards [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this way.
BCCE_CARD_FLICK.title: Flick
BCCE_CARD_LIMBER_UP.title: Limber Up
BCCE_CARD_HELPLESS_WALK.title: Underworld Passage
BCCE_CARD_HELPLESS_WALK.description: This turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for every 3 [gold]Souls[/gold] you play.
BCCE_CARD_CHARGED_STRIKE.title: Charged Strike
BCCE_CARD_CHARGED_STRIKE.description:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
At the end of this turn, gain {ChargedStrikePower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] for each {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} spent this turn.
At the end of your next turn, lose the accumulated [gold]Strength[/gold] unless you [gold]charge up[/gold] again that turn.
BCCE_CARD_PREDATION.title: Predation
BCCE_CARD_PREDATION.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Strength[/gold], a random enemy loses that much [gold]Strength[/gold] for {PredationPower:diff()} {PredationPower:plural:turn|turns}.
BCCE_CARD_SLAY.title: Slay
BCCE_CARD_SLAY.description:
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] 1 card.
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage [blue]2[/blue] times, dealing additional damage each hit equal to the difference between your [gold]Max HP[/gold] and [gold]current HP[/gold].
BCCE_CARD_CRIMSON_THIRST.title: Crimson Thirst
BCCE_CARD_CRIMSON_THIRST.description:
[gold]Burning Blood[/gold] and [gold]Black Blood[/gold] no longer heal you at the end of this combat.
Whenever a non-Minion enemy dies, raise your Max HP by {CrimsonThirstPower:diff()}.
BCCE_CARD_ORION.title: Orion
BCCE_CARD_TIDE.title: Tide
BCCE_CARD_TIDE.description:
Enemy loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
Gain {Stars:starIcons()} next turn.
BCCE_CARD_FIREFLY.title: Firefly
BCCE_CARD_FIREFLY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
If the last card you played spent or gained Stars, deal an additional {BonusDamage:diff()} damage and draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
BCCE_CARD_SATELLITE_CLUSTER.title: Satellite Cluster
BCCE_CARD_SATELLITE_CLUSTER.description: After playing this card, whenever you gain or spend a Star this turn, [gold]Forge[/gold] {SatelliteClusterPower:diff()} and gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
BCCE_CARD_GALAXY.title: Galaxy
BCCE_CARD_GALAXY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies 4 times.
Gain {BuffCount:diff()} random {BuffCount:plural:buff|buffs}.
BCCE_CARD_ASTRONOMICAL_NUMBER.title: Astronomical Number
BCCE_CARD_ASTRONOMICAL_NUMBER.descriptio: For every {StarsPerStack:diff()} {StarsPerStack:plural:Star|Stars} you spend, increase your damage to enemies by {DamageBonus:diff()}%.
BCCE_CARD_UNDERWORLD_BLADE.title: Underworld Blade
BCCE_CARD_UNDERWORLD_BLADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies twice.
Apply [gold]Doom[/gold] to each enemy equal to {DoomPercent:diff()}% of its Max HP.
This card costs {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} more for the rest of combat.
BCCE_CARD_NEBULA.title: Nebula
BCCE_CARD_NEBULA.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] to [gold]Transform[/gold] into a random 0-cost Colorless card.
BCCE_CARD_CONDUCTIVITY.title: Conductivity
BCCE_CARD_CONDUCTIVITY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Trigger the passive ability of your rightmost [gold]Lightning[/gold] Orb once for each enemy.
BCCE_CARD_COUNTER_EXECUTE.title: Counter-Execution
BCCE_CARD_COUNTER_EXECUTE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} {Repeat:plural:time|times}.
Trigger your rightmost Orb's passive ability once, then [gold]Evoke[/gold] your leftmost Orb.
BCCE_CARD_HUNDRED_THOUSAND_VOLTS.title: 100,000 Volts
BCCE_CARD_HUNDRED_THOUSAND_VOLTS.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} {Repeat:plural:time|times}.
For each hit that is not fully blocked, [gold]Channel[/gold] {Orbs:diff()} [gold]Lightning[/gold].
BCCE_CARD_FUNCTION.title: Function
BCCE_CARD_FUNCTION.description:
[gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Glass[/gold].
Choose 1 card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to discard.
BCCE_CARD_LOGIC.title: Logic
BCCE_CARD_LOGIC.description:
If you have an empty Orb slot, [gold]Channel[/gold] {Repeat:diff()} [gold]Frost[/gold].
Otherwise, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] this card and gain 1 Orb slot.
BCCE_CARD_OPEN_SOURCE.title: Open Source
BCCE_CARD_OPEN_SOURCE.description: When viewing your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], cards are shown in their actual draw order.
BCCE_CARD_VARIABLE_SUBSTITUTION.title: Variable Substitution
BCCE_CARD_VARIABLE_SUBSTITUTION.descript:
For every {OrbsPerStack:diff()} {OrbsPerStack:plural:Orb|Orbs} you [gold]Channel[/gold], gain {FocusGain:diff()} [gold]Focus[/gold].
At the start of your turn, gain an extra {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for every {FocusPerEnergy:diff()} [gold]Focus[/gold] you have.
BCCE_CARD_CALL_FROM_BEYOND.title: Call from Beyond
BCCE_CARD_CALL_FROM_BEYOND.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}. [gold]Osty[/gold] deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals additional damage equal to [gold]Osty's[/gold] current HP.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], permanently increase this card's Summon value by {SummonGainPercent:diff()}% of the enemy's Max HP for this run.
BCCE_CARD_OUT_OF_BODY.title: Out of Body
BCCE_CARD_OUT_OF_BODY.description:
[gold]Attacks[/gold] currently in ALL your piles cost {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} less until played.
Your [gold]Attacks[/gold] gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
BCCE_CARD_HALLOWEEN.title: Halloween
BCCE_CARD_HALLOWEEN.description:
The next two times [gold]Osty[/gold] would take fatal damage during the enemy turn, heal him to 50% and 25% of his Max HP, respectively.
Playing this card again resets the remaining uses.
